Potential persons who are to respond to the collection of information
SEC.1410 (06-02) contained in this form are not required to respond unless the form
displays a currently valid OMB control number.

OATH OR AFFIRMATION

I, Michael Bleich _, swear (or affirm) that, to the best of my knowledge and belief the accompanying
financial statement and supporting schedules pertaining to the firm of Scout Trading, LLC , as of
December 31, 2013, are true and correct. I further swear (or affirm) that neither the company nor any
partner, proprietor, principal officer or director has any proprietary interest in any account classified

solely as that of a customer, except as follows: NONE. / 5 CBE
